TS005 no-mutable-globals

Global state is immutable, so no two parts of the program race to own it.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: error
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Declare variables at the smallest possible scope, and minimize the number of variables in scope, to reduce the probability that variables are misused."
NASA P10 Rule 6: "Data objects must be declared at the smallest possible level of scope."
